summary: Primary-source lift (backlog task B16), first firing. Sixty medium-confidence counted records, taken in descending order of significance weight, had their stage-deciding official document located, read and cited by research subagents and then re-read by independent reviewers, who re-derived the stage and reset confidence. 27 records moved from medium to high confidence; the rest stay medium, mostly because the enrolled text of Public Law 119-21 and other large laws is cut short on govinfo.gov and was confirmed through agency preambles or the U.S. Code. Two stages changed: c19-01 moved from implemented 70 to in_progress 60 because the NHTSA fuel economy final rule (91 FR 61988) states an effective date of 2026-11-30, and c18-13 moved from blocked 15 to diverged 0 because the only injunction case was voluntarily dismissed on 2025-07-07 and OMB Memorandum M-25-29 keeps Executive Order 14063 in effect. Progress was lowered without a stage change on c26-01 (45 to 25), c14-39 (40 to 30), c18-02 (55 to 35) and c16-06 (80 to 72). Court status was set or corrected on 16 records. Three records were skipped at selection because their deciding document sits on a host that refuses fetches (c04-31, c05-24, c05-35 on state.gov; c05-08 on dhs.gov). About 40 of 200 web searches were used; the document fetches did the work. The counted set stays at 590.
title: Primary-source lift: 60 medium-confidence records re-read against their deciding documents
